title: PE (Portable Executable) signature
summary: A PE file begins with the DOS header 'MZ' (0x4D 0x5A) at offset 0, and the PE signature 'PE\x00\x00' (0x50 0x45 0x00 0x00) at the offset specified by e_lfanew (at offset 0x3C).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: e_lfanew at offset 0x3C points to the PE signature.
COFF header: Machine (2), NumberOfSections (2), TimeDateStamp (4), PointerToSymbolTable (4), NumberOfSymbols (4), SizeOfOptionalHeader (2), Characteristics (2).
